action.command: netstat -tlnp 2>/dev/null | head -10 || cat /proc/net/tcp /proc/net/tcp6 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR>1 {split($2,a,":"); print strtonum("0x" a[2])}' | sort -un | head -20
